name: Salmon with Greens & Crushed Potatoes
method: Boil the baby potatoes for 15 minutes, adding the green beans and broccoli for the last 4.
Meanwhile bake the salmon at 200°C for 12–14 minutes.
Lightly crush the potatoes with the crème fraîche, a squeeze of lemon and seasoning, and serve with the salmon and greens.
